ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/cream) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels concentrated in a central 'Y' shape extending from the peduncle; high-intensity pixels forming the primary surface of both lateral lobes; secondary yellowish-tan pixel clusters distributed across the distal and superior sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; vertex angle approximately 40 degrees; vertical depth approximately 1/6th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits 3-4 high-amplitude, irregular indentations and jagged peaks; right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations with a more continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex upward-outward curvature with significant jagged irregularities along the posterior margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured clusters of raised pixels localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep notches along the trailing edge of the left lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread yellowish-brown pigmentation overlaying the high-intensity cream regions of the fluke lobes.
